The average of 19 numbers is 58. The average of the first 12 numbers is 63.6 and the average of the last 8 numbers is 55.1. If the 12th number from the beginning is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 19 numbers = 58

The average of the first 12 numbers = 63.6

The average of the last 8 numbers = 55.1

**Formula used:**

Average= (Sum of all observations)/(Total number of observations)

**Calculation:**

The average of 19 numbers = 58

∴ Sum of 19 numbers = 19 × 58 = 1102

The average of the first 12 numbers = 63.6

∴ Sum of first 12 numbers = 12 × 63.6 = 763.2

The average of the last 8 numbers = 55.1

∴ Sum of last 8 numbers = 8 × 55.1 = 440.8

⇒ 12th number = {(763.2 + 440.8) – 1102} = 102

According to the question

The 12th number from the beginning is excluded.

The sum of the remaining numbers = 1102 – 102 = 1000

The average of the 18 remaining numbers = 1000over18 = 500over9 = {55}{5over9} 

** ∴ The average of the 18 remaining numbers is {55}{5over9}. **

questions.question: If HCF of 341, 434 and 620 is x, then the value of x lies between:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The Numbers 341, 434, and 620 

Their HCF is x

**Concept used:**

The full form of HCF in Maths is the Highest Common Factor.

HCF of two or more numbers is the greatest factor that divides the numbers.

For example:

4 = 2 × 2

6 = 2 × 3

⇒ 2 is the HCF of 4 and 6.

Calculation:

Prime factorization of the numbers are:

341 = 11 × 31

434 = 2 × 7 × 31

And 620 = 2² × 5 × 31

So, HCF = 31

**∴ x = 31 and it lies between 30 and 35.**

questions.question: The ratio of alcohol and water in a solution is 4 ∶ 3. In 350 mL of this solution, how much water (in mL) should be added to get a solution containing alcohol and water in the ratio 5 ∶ 6?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio 350 mL solution of alcohol and water is 4 : 3

After adding water ratio becomes 5: 6

**Calculation:**

Let the quantity of alcohol and water be 4x and 3x respectively

According to the statement,

4x + 3x = 350

⇒ 7x = 350 

⇒ x = 50

Thus, the quantity of alcohol = 4x = 4 × 50 = 200 mL

And, the quantity of water = 3x = 3 × 50 = 150 mL

If 'a' mL of water is mixed into the solution then the ratio becomes 5: 6

⇒ 200/(150 + a) = 5/6

⇒ 1200 = 750 + 5a

⇒ 5a = 450

⇒ a = 90

**∴ 90 mL of water is mixed with the solution.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** The initial ratio of alcohol and water is 4 : 3

The final ratio of alcohol and water is 5: 6

If only water is added to the solution, the quantity of alcohol will not change

So, equating alcohol in the ratios

4 : 3 × 5 = 20 : 15

5 : 6 × 4 = 20 : 24

Initially total quantity is (20 + 15) = 35 ——→ 350 mL

Increased quantity of water (24 - 15) = 9 ——→ **90 mL**

**∴ The correct answer is 90 mL**

questions.question: The simple interest on a certain sum at 6.4% p.a. for 3(3)/(4) years is Rs. 1,896. What will be the amount (in Rs.) of the same sum at the same rate in 6(1)/(4) years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest = 6.4%

Time in the first situation = {3}{3over4} years = 15over4 years

Time in the second situation = {6}{1over4} years = 25over4 years

Simple interest = Rs. 1896

**Formula used:**

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = Principal + S.I.

Where, P = Principle, R = Rate of interest

T = Time and S.I. = Simple interest

**Calculation:**

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 1896 = (P×6.4×15)over(4×100) 

⇒ P = (1896×4×100)over(6.4×15) 

⇒ P = (1896 × 400)/96 = Rs. 7900

Simple interest on the same rate in {6}{1over4} years.

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ S.I = (7900×6.4×25)over(4×100) 

⇒ S.I. = (79 × 160)/4 = Rs. 3160

Amount = Principal + S.I

⇒Amount = (7900 + 3160) = Rs. 11060

**∴ Hence, the amount is Rs. 11060.**

Time taken by C = 24/1 = 24 days.

Hence, Time taken by C to complete the work is 24 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: If a, b and c are positive numbers such that (a² + b²) ∶ (b² + c²) ∶ (c² + a²) = 34 ∶ 61 ∶ 45, then a + b ∶ b + c ∶ c + a =
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a, b, c ∈ Z

(a2 + b2) ∶ (b2 + c2) ∶ (c2 + a2) = 34 ∶ 61 ∶ 45

**Calculation:**

Let, the common factor = x²

a2 + b2 = 34x2

⇒ b2 = 34x2 - a2 ---(1)

b2 + c2 = 61x2

Putting the value of b2,

⇒ 34x2 - a2 + c2 = 61x2

⇒ c2 - a2 = 61x2 - 34x2 

⇒ c2 - a2 = 27x2

⇒ c2 = 27x2 + a2 ---(2)

c2 + a2 = 45x2 

Putting the value of c2,

⇒ 27x2 + a2 + a2 = 45x2

⇒ 2a2 = 45x2 - 27x2 

⇒ a2 = 18x2/2 = 9x2

⇒ a = 3x

So, c2 = 27x2 + 9x2 = 36x2

⇒ c = 6x

Putting the value of a2 in equation (1),

b2 = 34x2 - 9x² = 25x²

⇒ b = 5x

Now, (a + b) : (b + c) : (c + a)

⇒ (3x + 5x) : (5x + 6x) : (6x + 3x)

⇒ 8x : 11x : 9x

⇒ 8 : 11 : 9

**∴ The ratio a + b ∶ b + c ∶ c + a is 8 : 11 : 9 **

questions.question: What is the volume of the largest right circular cone that can be cut out of a cube of edge 12 cm (correct to two decimal places)?

For the largest cone inscribed in a cube of edge a, the radius is a/2 and the height is a.

Direct formula for Volume = πa³ ÷ 12

Volume = (22/7 × 12³) ÷ 12 = 22/7 × 144

Volume = 3168 ÷ 7 ≈ 452.57 cm³

The base diameter and height of the cone are equal to the edge of the cube (a). Volume = πa³ ÷ 12.

questions.question: A square of side 6sqrt 2 cm is inscribed in a circle. What is the area (in cm²) of the circle excluding the square (correct to the nearest integer)? (Use π = frac{{22}}{7})

When a square is inscribed in a circle, Diameter of circle = Diagonal of square.

Diagonal of square = side × √2 = (6√2) × √2 = 12 cm.

Radius (r) = Diameter ÷ 2 = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm.

Required Area = Area of Circle − Area of Square = (π × 6²) − (6√2)².

Area = 113.14 − 72 = 41.14 ≈ 41 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 41 cm².**

Formula: Area of Circle = πr² | Area of Square = side²

⇒ Diagonal of square = √2 × side = √2 × 6√2 = 12 cm

⇒ Diameter of the circle = Diagonal of the square = 12 cm

⇒ Radius (r) of the circle = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm

⇒ Area of the circle = (22/7) × 6 × 6 = 792 ÷ 7 = 113.1428 cm²

⇒ Area of the square = (6√2) × (6√2) = 36 × 2 = 72 cm²

⇒ Remaining Area = 113.1428 − 72 = 41.1428 cm²

⇒ Rounded to nearest integer = 41 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 41 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Circumcircle of a Square

When a circle circumscribes a square of side 'a', the radius (R) is half of the diagonal: R = a√2 ÷ 2 = a ÷ √2.

Incircle of a Square

When a circle is inscribed within a square of side 'a', the radius (r) is half of the side: r = a ÷ 2.

questions.question: The speed of a bus increases by 4 km/hr after every one hour. If the distance travelled in the first one hour was 55 km, then what was the total distance travelled in 13 hours?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of car increases after every hour = 4 km / h

Distance travelled in 1st one hour = 55 km

Formula used :

Sum of n terms of an AP = n/2[2a + (n - 1)d]

AP = Arithmetic progression 

**Calculation:**

Distance travelled in 2nd hour = 55 + 4 = 59 km

Distance travelled in 3rd hour 59 + 4 = 63 km

Distance travelled by car in every hour will be in AP 

55, 59, 63 ... up to 13 terms. 

First term = a = 55, common difference = d = 59 - 55 = 4,

Number of terms = n = 13

Total distance travelled in 13 hours = 13 / 2 [ 2 x 55 + ( 13 - 1 ) 4 ] 

⇒ 13 / 2 ( 110 + 48 )

⇒ 13 × 79 = 1027 km

**Hence, the total distance travelled in 13 hours is 1027 km.**
